An unmatched [ in a link label is escaped so the link survives

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<a href=\"S\">[A;B)</a>");
var_dump($result->content);
```
